source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of list applications (PDF 95).

items: Data rakhna aur badalna: records, entries aur qeematein, aasan dakhila, hatana aur pohanch.
Stack aur queue banana: lists stacks (LIFO) aur queues (FIFO) bana sakti hain.
Sorting aur searching: bubble sort, selection sort aur binary search aksar lists par chalte hain.
Function arguments: lists function ko kai qeematein bhejti hain.
Matrix ke amal: lists ki list matrix ki qataarein dikha sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Lists se doosre data structures kaise banaye ja sakte hain (short question 7)?
blocks.explanation: Stack push ke liye append() aur aakhir se hatane ke liye pop() istemal karta hai; queue enqueue ke liye append() aur aage se dequeue ke liye pop(0); tree ka node apne bachchon ki list rakhta hai; aur graph har vertex ke liye parosiyon ki list (adjacency list) rakh sakta hai. Lists ki list matrix bhi banati hai.

items: Lists data rakhti, stacks aur queues banati, sorting aur searching mein kaam aati, arguments bhejti aur matrices banati hain.
